observations.observation: The competition metric is mean column-wise Spearman correlation, a rank-based metric.
observations.evidence: task.md evaluation section describes mean column-wise Spearman's correlation; direction higher is better.

observations.observation: The current version v46 scores lower than the best earlier versions.
The versions that scored above 0.42 included a per-column discretization / quantized blending postprocessing.
observations.evidence: history.md v38 (y_pred_new with per-column adjusted values, 0.42704) and v45 (KBinsDiscretizer with constant-column fallback and min-max rescale, 0.42580).

observations.observation: Removing that postprocessing caused a large score drop.
observations.evidence: history.md v39->v40 removed per-column quantized blending: 0.42442 -> 0.38139 (-0.043); v45->v46 removed KBins discretization: 0.42580 -> 0.38762 (-0.038).

observations.observation: The current code applies any postprocessing to y_pred before writing the submission.
observations.evidence: current_code.py lines 47-65: y_pred = evaluator.run(test_df) is written directly into out_df with no transformation.

observations.observation: Switching experiment checkpoints alone has produced consistent gains in the history.
observations.evidence: history.md: checkpoint switches gave mixed results (v30 +0.003, v31 -0.001, v34 -0.006, v35 +0.004); no systematic improvement.

observations.observation: Switching to the cross-encoder evaluator improved the score when tried.
Rank-based blending of folds beat mean blending.
observations.evidence: history.md v33 blend_strategy 'rank' scored 0.38345 vs 0.38356 for v31 with 'mean'; essentially no difference.

observations.observation: The memory notes recommend handling degenerate bins and ties when discretizing for an ordinal/rank metric.
observations.evidence: memory/attention/t-7-4-map-continuous-scores-to-discrete-labels.md lists 'Merge or threshold near-equal scores' and 'Handle degenerate bins and ties' as options, with check E154 (predictions correspond to a small set of repeated target levels).

action_summary: Kept the v46 evaluator pipeline (BiEncoderEvaluator on experiment 2020_02_01__19_10_50__329 with NER and math preprocessing) and restored the prediction postprocessing that the two best-scoring versions (v38, v45) used and v46 removed: each of the 30 target columns is quantized with a quantile KBinsDiscretizer (30 bins, ordinal encoding), columns that collapse to a single bin are reverted to the raw continuous predictions, each discretized column is min-max rescaled to [0,1], and a guard ensures no column is constant (which would score NaN/0 Spearman). The submission is written from the postprocessed array in the required format.
